Convert signatures to gene sets

Source: R/getGeneSets.R
getGeneSets.Rd

Takes the topK genes with the largest (and/or smallest) weights in each signature.

Usage

getGeneSets(
  signatures,
  topK = 200,
  direction = c("up", "both", "down"),
  universe = rownames(signatures)
)

Arguments

signatures

Signature weight matrix (genes x signatures), as returned by loadSignatures().

topK

Number of genes per gene set.

direction

"up" (top weights) and "down" (bottom weights) make one set per signature, named as the signature; "both" makes two sets per signature, named with _UP and _DN suffixes.

universe

Genes to choose from, for example the names of the statistic vector the gene sets will be tested against. Restricting to it keeps every gene set at topK genes after fgsea drops genes that are missing from the statistic.

Value

A named list of character vectors.

Examples

# \donttest{
signatures <- loadSignatures("mmu", geneId = "entrez")
geneSets <- getGeneSets(signatures, topK = 5)
geneSets[["TBX21"]]
#> [1] "57765"  "12766"  "16162"  "14945"  "235534"
# }
